remarks: Magnificently Captivating and Updated Condo in Downtown Stamford! Located in a desirable, pet-friendly building, this 3BR/2BA recently-renovated property offers a leisurely lifestyle with tons of nearby conveniences, such as bus stops (20+ft), Metro North to NYC (1-mile), and highly-rated restaurants (0.2+miles). Benefiting from west facing sunset views, the entertainment-ready 6th floor residence features a welcoming entry with a coat closet, openly flowing layout and a spacious living room with sliding glass doors to a relaxing screened-in terrace. Stylish vibes resonate from the upgraded eat-in kitchen, which has updated stainless-steel appliances, quartz countertops and a beautiful island that opens seamlessly into living room area - perfect for entertaining! After an enjoyable day, retire to the oversized primary bedroom with a walk-in closet, two secondary closets, and a renovated en suite featuring a tub/shower combo. Two additional bedrooms dazzle with a generous closet space, while the full guest bathroom impresses with a second updated shower/tub combo. Heating & Central Air included. Other features: indoor parking, two hall closets, community room, storage lockers, 24-hr security, on-site superintendent, bike storage, & full-service gym, and much more!
